## Ctx.renderPreCheckout() method

Answers the active pre-checkout query with a template-backed error message.

**Signature:**

```typescript
renderPreCheckout(ok: boolean, data: IData | null | undefined, AGBaseId: string, options?: IOptPreCheckout | null): Promise<true>;
```

**Returns:**

True on success.

## Remarks

Template-backed counterpart to [Ctx.answerPreCheckout()](./gramstax.ctx.answerprecheckout.md)<!-- -->: the `<g-precheckout-error>` block supplies the `error_message` shown when payment is declined (multilang via `data`<!-- -->). The block is always resolved — even for `ok=true` — as fail-fast validation that the template exists. A string `options` overrides the block text as the error message.

Observe-only send-error coverage (mirrors `renderDice`<!-- -->): failures are classified via `Ctx.classifySendError`<!-- -->, reported to `notifySendError`<!-- -->, and logged (`retryable` → `log.error`<!-- -->, `fallback-text` → `log.warn`<!-- -->). After notify+log the original error is ALWAYS rethrown untouched.

Telegram requires the answer within 10 seconds of the query.

## Example


```typescript
async handlePreCheckout() {
  await this.renderPreCheckout(false, undefined, `pay-declined-card`)
}
```
